faq_heading: Homes near North Surrey Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the North Surrey Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the North Surrey Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names North Surrey Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to North Surrey Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Serpentine Heights Elementary (0.6 km south-east), William F. Davidson Elementary (1.1 km north-west) and Woodland Park Elementary (1.1 km south).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of North Surrey Secondary

22 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of North Surrey Secondary in a straight line (16 elementary, 3 secondary, 3 other; 5 independent). The closest is Serpentine Heights Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Holly Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Johnston Heights Secondary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is Surrey Christian School (1.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Frost Road Elementary (2.0 km). Other secondary schools close by: Johnston Heights Secondary (1.3 km north-west), Holy Cross Regional High School (1.5 km south), Fraser Heights Secondary (2.4 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Johnston Heights Secondary, 1.3 km north-west of North Surrey Secondary.
